blocking_findings.finding: R3 removes the inappropriate historical-hash equality gate and records historical equality diagnostically. However, after copying the validated ROOT/cache NPY and sidecar files into OUT/predictions, it hashes those collected copies for terminal_inventory.json and only requires six paths/counts plus non-null collected hashes. It does not compare the collected NPY and sidecar SHA/bytes to the per-run fresh export_receipt hashes in status. A corrupted or truncated copy can therefore still satisfy terminal.complete.
blocking_findings.consequence: The recovery can report complete despite delivering prediction bytes that differ from the exact fresh files which passed checkpoint/sidecar/shape/order/finiteness validation.
blocking_findings.smallest_fix: For each of the three runs, compare terminal file inventory SHA and byte count for its collected predictions/<filename>.npy and .json against that run's fresh status export_receipt prediction_sha256/prediction_bytes and sidecar_sha256. Require all six fresh-copy comparisons and the exact six expected paths for complete. Keep historical hashes diagnostic only.
